hooks.name: Keep README feature list in sync
hooks.description: When a spec task list changes, updates the README Features section so it lists only what is actually built.

action.prompt: A spec tasks.md under .kiro/specs/ just changed. Update the '## Features' section of README.md (create the section, or README.md itself, if missing) so it reflects shipped work only: list a user-facing feature from docs/BRIEF.md's MVP scope as built only when every non-optional task that implements it is checked ([x]) in its spec's tasks.md, and list the rest under '### In progress'. Use one short plain-language line per feature, keep the brief's order, and do not touch any other README section. Do not edit any tasks.md file.
